entities.name: CellGroupConfig Information Element
entities.description: IE containing configuration parameters for a cell group provided by the network to configure MCG and SCG.

entities.name: Reconfiguration with sync
entities.description: Procedure performed when CellGroupConfig contains spCellConfig with reconfigurationWithSync.

entities.name: RLC bearer release
entities.description: Procedure performed when CellGroupConfig contains rlc-BearerToReleaseList or rlc-BearerToReleaseListExt.

entities.name: RLC bearer addition/modification
entities.description: Procedure performed when CellGroupConfig contains rlc-BearerToAddModList.

entities.name: MAC entity configuration
entities.description: Procedure to configure MAC entity when CellGroupConfig contains mac-CellGroupConfig.

entities.name: SCell release
entities.description: Procedure performed when CellGroupConfig contains sCellToReleaseList.

entities.name: SpCell configuration
entities.description: Procedure performed when CellGroupConfig contains spCellConfig.

entities.name: SCell addition/modification
entities.description: Procedure performed when CellGroupConfig contains sCellToAddModList.

entities.name: BH RLC channel release
entities.description: Procedure performed when CellGroupConfig contains bh-RLC-ChannelToReleaseList.

entities.name: BH RLC channel addition/modification
entities.description: Procedure performed when CellGroupConfig contains bh-RLC-ChannelToAddModList.

entities.name: Uu Relay RLC channel release
entities.description: Procedure performed when CellGroupConfig contains uu-Relay-RLC-ChannelToReleaseList.

entities.name: Uu Relay RLC channel addition/modification
entities.description: Procedure performed when CellGroupConfig contains uu-Relay-RLC-ChannelToAddModList.

relations.description: Triggers Reconfiguration with sync procedure when spCellConfig with reconfigurationWithSync is present.
Triggers RLC bearer release procedure when rlc-BearerToReleaseList or rlc-BearerToReleaseListExt is present.
Triggers RLC bearer addition/modification procedure when rlc-BearerToAddModList is present.
Triggers MAC entity configuration procedure when mac-CellGroupConfig is present.
Triggers SCell release procedure when sCellToReleaseList is present.
Triggers SpCell configuration procedure when spCellConfig is present.
Triggers SCell addition/modification procedure when sCellToAddModList is present.
Triggers BH RLC channel release procedure when bh-RLC-ChannelToReleaseList is present.
Triggers BH RLC channel addition/modification procedure when bh-RLC-ChannelToAddModList is present.
Triggers Uu Relay RLC channel release procedure when uu-Relay-RLC-ChannelToReleaseList is present.
Triggers Uu Relay RLC channel addition/modification procedure when uu-Relay-RLC-ChannelToAddModList is present.
